questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

FASCINATE
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'captivate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look into the meanings of the given word and the given options :
 
 
• **Fascinate**: To have someone’s complete interest and attention.

 
 
• Example: *The children were **fascinated** by the story.*
 
 
 
• **Captivate**: attract and hold the interest and attention of; charm.
 
 
• Example: *Her blue eyes and blonde hair **captivated** him.* ​
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, the word **Captivate** is the most appropriate word similar to **Fascinate.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let’s explore the meaning of other options :
 
 
• **Reject** (verb): To refuse to accept, accede to, or believe.

 
 
• **Example**: *The company **rejected** his business proposal.*
 
 
 
• **Repel** (verb): To force or drive back, causing a strong feeling of dislike.
 
 
• **Example:** *It is not true that eating garlic **repels** mosquitoes.*
 
 
 
• **Love** (noun): An intense feeling of deep affection.
 
 
• **Example**: *Innocence of babies fill parents with feelings of **love.***

questions.question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

Avoid the puddles caused by the downpour was quite a problem while I was driving.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Avoid the puddles."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Sentences always begin with a **subject** and not with a **verb.**
 
• Here, **Avoid** is used which is a **verb**. The erroneous part **“Avoid the puddles”** should be **“ Avoiding the puddles”.**
 
• Here, **Avoiding** is a **gerund** that makes the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• **Therefore**, the correct answer is **option 1. ​**

**Correct Sentence: __*****__Avoiding the puddles__** caused by the downpour was quite a problem while I was driving.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**__Additional Information__**

__
 
• A **Gerund** is a non-finite__ **verb** that functions as a noun. It is formed by adding **‘ing’** with a verb. (verb**-ing**) A gerund can be either the subject or object of a sentence. The **gerund **always has the same function as a **noun.**

 
 
• **Example**: *Dancing is a good exercise.*

questions.question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

The old lady finds it difficult to climb the steep steps of the train and asked for help.
questions.solution:
The erroneous segment in the sentence is **finds it .** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the improper use of parallelism is there .
 
• **Parallelism is the practice of lining up all your verb tenses when you have a list of them in one sentence.**
 
• When two or more **verbs** have the same subject the verbs must be **parallel.**
 
 
• In the above sentence , The old lady is the** only subject** for 2 verbs used in the sentence i.e.** finds **and **asked**. Both are indifferent **tenses** *finds* is in** V1** and *asked *is in **V2 **form.
 
 
 
• Therefore as per the rule of **conjunction** with **parallelism,** the above sentence should be in the **simple past tense **as in accordance with the verb **asked.** 
 
• The structure of **simple past tense**: **Subject + V2.**
 
• Hence, instead of **finds it** , we will use **found** to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• So, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

India's market for electronic goods is __one of the large market__ in the world.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'One of the largest markets'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• An adjective is a word that describes a noun or a pronoun. 
 
• The **superlative** degree is used to describe an object out of a group.
 
 
• **Example**: Gold **is the most **precious metal.
 
 
 
• The noun after **'one of'** should always be **plural **in form. 
 
 
• **Example**: He is **one of the best writers** that have ever lived. 
 
 
 
• According to the rules and examples above, the sentence given in **option 2)** has the correct superlative degree.

 

**Correct sentence :__** *India's market for electric goods is **one of the largest markets** in the world .*
